scope: Observed independent waits with node actions; ACK time is derived from the lifecycle audit's last-ACK interval. Phase intersections partition that interval and do not add quantiles. Native service timestamps are observed scheduler/model-worker intervals, not CUDA launch or kernel time. Early verified reuse is an outcome-conditioned cohort, not a causal scheduling comparison. Native-arrival waiting includes admission, restoration and control work; it is not pure GPU queueing. No FULL Host hit does not establish complete Mamba readiness. Missing restore samples are unknown, and no exposed-stall or counterfactual saving is inferred. Completion windows include independent waits without node commands; positive native FULL restore is an explicitly outcome-conditioned subset. These endpoint intervals include notification/planning work and are not guaranteed available DMA overlap.
